verdict.rationale: Docusign documents its own workflow automation: configurable workflows, automated workflows on the IAM platform, and a drag-and-drop CLM editor for designing contract processes. That plausibly covers rule-driven automation, but no evidence explicitly describes event triggers (e.g. 'when envelope completed, do X') or user-defined rule conditions. missing for 10: explicit event-trigger definitions, user-authored rule/condition logic for actions, documentation of trigger types, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
